close_reason: Satisfied by current compiler2 artifact/native product boundary: no live world.transport_plan reads remain; native consumes BackendProgram/MaterializedTransportPlan.
description: Artifact and native lowering still reach back into the root-global TransportPlan after MaterializedProgram has copied a materialized transport handoff. That violates the documented one-way artifact boundary: AbiReady should consume MaterializedProgram, Backend should consume EmissionReadyProgram, and Native should consume BackendProgram. Move callable/boundary fact rows needed by ABI/native into MaterializedTransportPlan and remove downstream world.transport_plan(root) reads.
title: Compiler2 artifact ladder must not reread live TransportPlan
